status: post-readback protocol robustness fixed before endpoint
question: Does prior-only species x SiteID memory targeting persist when the paired comparison is forced to cross outside the NAAMP 0-3-day post-rain target window?

sample.base: Physically stable pairs with prior-only candidate pool and >=5 candidate cells in both prior-same-site and prior-route-only groups.
sample.primary_restriction: dry_days_since_rain >=4, so the drier survey lies outside the 0-3 day target window.
sample.stricter_secondary: wet_days_since_rain >=4 as well, so both surveys lie outside the 0-3 day window.

model: Unchanged weighted model: CI3 same-site minus route-only rate difference ~ rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber; opportunity weights; route-clustered covariance.
stricter_secondary: Report if >=100 pairs and >=75 routes; no success gate.
same_observer: Apply the primary restriction to same-observer pairs and report if >=350 pairs and >=125 routes; directional sensitivity only.
interpretation: Support shows rain-selective local-memory targeting is not restricted to comparisons wholly inside the programme's 0-3-day post-rain scheduling window.
This does not remove all survey-scheduling confounding or establish randomized rainfall.
No continuous occupancy, biological memory, individual fidelity, or reproductive-success claim.
